selected_evidence.requirement: Persistent logging with 14-day retention and bounded disk growth
selected_evidence.summary: The installed and parsed policy specifies persistent storage, 14-day retention, and a 512 MiB limit. Journald reports /var/log/journal as its live store with that limit, remains active, and passes integrity verification.

Captured healthy baseline boot ID ab09f655-9d2b-4574-a072-db67e58266c2, acknowledged the scheduled reboot, observed new boot ID e99e2270-2420-4b03-a996-9451840956d8, and proved full recovery with active journald, persisted policy, readable pre-reboot data, writable post-reboot data, and valid journal files.

chown root:root "$tmpfile"
mv "$tmpfile" /etc/systemd/journald.conf.d/60-local-retention.conf
trap - EXIT HUP INT TERM
install -d -m 2755 -o root -g systemd-journal /var/log/journal

commands.command:
set -eu
unit="[REDACTED]-$(date +%s)"
systemd-run --quiet --unit="$unit" --on-active=5s --timer-property=AccuracySec=1s /usr/bin/systemctl reboot
printf 'REBOOT_SCHEDULED unit=%s delay=5s current_boot_id=' "$unit"
cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id

printf 'POLL_BOOT_ID='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf 'SYSTEM_STATE='; systemctl is-system-running || true

set -eu
old_boot_id='ab09f655-9d2b-4574-a072-db67e58266c2'
new_boot_id=$(cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id)
printf 'POST_REBOOT_BOOT_ID=%s\n' "$new_boot_id"
test "$new_boot_id" != "$old_boot_id"
printf 'BOOT_ID_CHANGED=yes\n'
printf 'SYSTEM_STATE='; systemctl is-system-running
printf 'JOURNAL_SERVICE_STATE='; systemctl is-active systemd-journald.service
printf '\nPERSISTED_POLICY:\n'
systemd-analyze cat-config systemd/journald.conf | awk -F= '/^(Storage|MaxRetentionSec|SystemMaxUse)=/ {print}'
printf '\nPRE_REBOOT_RECORD_RECOVERED:\n'
journalctl -t log-retention-verify --grep "log-retention-pre-reboot-$old_boot_id" -n 1 --no-pager -o short-iso
post_marker="log-retention-post-reboot-$new_boot_id"
logger -p user.notice -t log-retention-verify "$post_marker"
journalctl --sync
printf '\nPOST_REBOOT_RECORD_WRITABLE:\n'
journalctl -t log-retention-verify --grep "$post_marker" -n 1 --no-pager -o short-iso
printf '\nBOOT_HISTORY:\n'
journalctl --list-boots --no-pager | tail -5
printf '\nLIVE_PERSISTENT_STORAGE_LIMIT:\n'
journalctl -u systemd-journald.service -b --no-pager -o cat | grep 'System Journal' | tail -1
journalctl --disk-usage
printf '\nJOURNAL_FILE_INTEGRITY:\n'
journalctl --verify --quiet
printf 'journal_verify=PASS\n'
